original.statement: Pod annotation policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility, deprecated since v1.15, has been removed in Cilium 1.17.0.

decision.reason: [ev-7424e74176c0] states that support for L7 protocol visibility using the Pod annotation `policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility` has been removed, so change type "removed" is right. The thing that stops being honoured is a configuration key (an annotation) on Pod objects, and config-key is the closest family. The proposed path copies the annotation name exactly, and component=Pod names the object that holds the key, the way a ConfigMap name does for config-key. All validator checks were inconclusive (render failed), so this rests on the upgrade-note text alone.
